warnings.missing: File no longer on the share

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: What is on air, and what still needs to be set up.
dashboard.setupIntro: Complete these steps to go on air.
dashboard.stepMail: Configure the mail server for alerts

control.title: Control room
control.intro: Follow and steer what goes on air, per channel.
control.emptySchedule: Nothing planned in the next 30 hours.
control.noAtem: No ATEM linked to this channel. Set one in Channels.
control.manualHint: Automation switches again at the next item. Turn automation off to stay in control.
control.noChannelsIntro: Create a channel first and link it to an ATEM and a studio node.

media.intro: Video files from the UNAS Pro. New files appear automatically; durations are measured for you.
media.hostHint: IP address or name of the UNAS.
media.subfolderHint: Optional. Must match the CasparCG media folder on the studio node.
media.localHint: Absolute path, for example a bind mount from the Proxmox host.
media.confirmDeleteSource: Remove share {{name}}? Its files disappear from blocks too.
media.noSourcesIntro: Connect the UNAS Pro to see your video files here.
media.title: Title
media.titleHint: Shown in the programme guide and the up-next bar.

blocks.title: TV blocks
blocks.intro: A block is a reusable rundown: programmes, ad breaks, jingles and live sources in order.
blocks.select: Choose a block on the left, or create a new one.
blocks.emptyRundown: Empty. Add media, an ad break or a live source.
blocks.inUse: This block is still scheduled. Delete it and remove it from the schedule?

ads.title: Ad breaks
ads.intro: Commercial breaks you can drop into any TV block. The channel logo is hidden during ads.
ads.select: Choose an ad break on the left, or create a new one.
ads.emptyRundown: Empty. Add commercials from the media library.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: Plan per day what goes on air. Each entry starts exactly on time; an overrun is cut.
schedule.epgTitleHint: Leave empty to use the block name.
schedule.copyIntro: Copy all programmes of {{day}} to the following days, at the same times.

epg.title: Programme guide
epg.intro: Generated from the schedule. Share the XMLTV feed with set-top boxes, IPTV middleware or your website.
epg.feedIntro: Anyone with this link can read the guide.
epg.publicUrlHint: For example https://manager.example.com behind the reverse proxy. Also used by the studio node to load the logo and subtitles.
epg.regenerateConfirm: The current link stops working. Continue?

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.intro: On-screen graphics per channel, rendered live by the studio node on top of the video.
graphics.enabledHint: Turns all graphics for this channel on or off.
graphics.logoHint: PNG or SVG with a transparent background.
graphics.upNextHint: Shows the next programme shortly before the current one ends.
graphics.tickerPlaceholder: Text that scrolls along the bottom
graphics.previewHint: Preview. Changes go on air after Save.
graphics.subtitlesHint: Shows a .srt or .vtt file with the same name as the clip (e.g. Show.srt or Show.nl.srt next to Show.mp4).
graphics.subtitleExample: This is what a subtitle looks like

channels.title: Channels
channels.intro: A channel links the schedule to a studio node output and an ATEM switcher.
channels.none: No channels yet. Add your first channel.
channels.maxHint: One studio node can play out at most 2 channels.
channels.playoutInputHint: ATEM input the studio node output for this channel is cabled to.
channels.fallbackInputHint: Shown when nothing is planned (e.g. colour bars or a station ident).
channels.casparChannelHint: Each CasparCG channel drives one DeckLink output.
channels.fillerHint: Loops when the schedule has a gap. Without it the fallback input is used.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: The ATEM switchers and studio nodes this management node controls, and the live sources you can switch to.
devices.atemsIntro: Every model works: the model, inputs and M/E rows are read from the switcher.
devices.studiosIntro: Windows machines with CasparCG and a DeckLink card.
devices.liveIntro: Cameras or studios on an ATEM input, or an RTMP stream that a studio node puts on SDI.
devices.atemHostHint: Shown in ATEM Setup under Network.
devices.atemInputHint: Number of the ATEM input this source arrives on.
devices.streamUrlHint: rtmp://, srt:// or udp://. CasparCG listens or pulls depending on the URL.

errors.missing_tool: A required program is missing on the server (smbclient/ffprobe).
errors.validation_failed: Check the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.unsupported_image: Use a PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG image.
errors.no_atem: No ATEM linked to this channel.
errors.unsupported_file_name: File names with quotes are not supported.
